A '''gravity mine''', or '''interdiction mine''', was a type of mine used to create a [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]] for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] interdiction purposes.

==Purpose==
The gravity mines created [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadows]] that pulled the ships into realspace and made them unable to jump again, but unlike large interdictors, they were much smaller and more difficult to detect with sensors. Also, there could be up to hundreds of mines spread across the area to create an overlapping larger mass shadow. Some more expensive mines could even magnetically attach itself to enemy starships, making them unable to be destroyed without outside assistance.

==History==
The [[Imperial Hyperspace Security Net]] which was based in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], used gravity mines and [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]] as a preemptive against illegal [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. [[Warlord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] used gravity mines to prevent the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]] from leaving the [[Battle of Mindor|battle of]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].

[[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] used gravity mines instead of expensive interdictor ships to keep the major hyperspace lines blocked from both the [[Empire-in-exile]] and the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]].
